community_list_entries.name: EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks

phase1_classification.kind_reason: New egocentric video benchmark (189 household tasks, 699 QA pairs) for cross-event causal memory in long-horizon embodied tasks: next-action prediction from history and causal traceback to past events. The project page says the public dataset release is pending.
